messages:
maya: Quick thread to coordinate a docs PR: consolidating Dedicated Capacity provisioning examples + autoscale policy variants. I split the changes into 3 commits: samples, link fixes, and a short migration guide.
devin: can you paste the PR link?
maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4857
alex: I'll review the samples commit. Are we keeping terraform and SDK examples side-by-side or moving SDKs to a separate snippets appendix?
maya: Keep both where they help explain step-by-step; move longer multi-language snippets into an appendix (call it "snippets catalog").
priya: Noticed a terminology mismatch: the docs use both "preemption" and "eviction" interchangeably. That'll confuse customers when provisioning reserved pools. Propose an explicit glossary entry and an FAQ blurb.
devin: agreed. Also add a brief example explaining eviction behavior with a node drain scenario.
maya: good idea. Devin, can you draft the 3-line example?
devin: sure: ```bash
# simulate eviction: mark node unschedulable and observe tenant fallback
kubectl cordon gpu-node-5
kubectl drain gpu-node-5 --ignore-daemonsets --force
```
alex: On autoscale policy variants: we had 'steady' vs 'burst' before. Suggest renaming to 'sustained' and 'burst/ephemeral' to be clearer. Also include a CSV-like compact matrix for quick ops reference.
priya: I updated one of the Python SDK snippets to the new client factory. Also found an old JS snippet that used `redwood.init()`  that's gone now. Left an inline PR suggestion.
maya: thanks. We'll keep a short migration note at top of page listing removed methods and replacements.
docs-bot: link-checker / run  PR#4857  failures: 2 broken links detected (isolation-decorators.md anchor, sla-matrix internal link).
infra-runner: pinging infra owners about the internal SLA link. We can mirror a non-sensitive summary in docs and reference the internal matrix for enterprise customers.
devin: For tenant isolation I added a tiny YAML snippet (6 lines) showing resource labels and an isolation annotation: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: DedicatedPool
metadata:
  name: acme-pool
  annotations:
    redwood.io/isolation: "noisy-tenant"
```
alex: That YAML is perfect for oncall playbooks. Recommend adding a one-sentence rationale: "Apply isolation annotations to route noisy tenants to dedicated pools to reduce SLO impact."
priya: I fixed the JS snippet and updated docs to use `Client.create({apiKey})` across examples. Also added a small Terraform provider block sample.
maya: I pushed edits addressing the link-checker output and added the glossary entry for preemption vs eviction. One remaining TODO: compact autoscale table units (tokens/sec vs requests/min).
devin: I'll normalize units to requests/min and add a footnote about token-to-request conversions.
docs-bot: docs-ci / build  PR#4857  success :white_check_mark: (https://ci.internal/4857/build)

maya: Great work. I'll merge after the tiny autoscale unit fix. Filing a follow-up issue for the snippets catalog epic.
